documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1842 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 21.250, v -1.250 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation 179.389 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 2009 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_2009 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 20th to 22nd Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front), widened to 5.5 m along the front because the fitted strip was narrower than any house of the avenue (T-2690). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: '2½B; rear1B' printed on the 1911 sheet: 2 full storeys and a half storey in the roof.

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s35fp-2009-b1 p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 88% of its fill; s35fp-2009-b1 p1 (main, brick), rectangle 2 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 88% of its fill; s35fp-2009-b1 p1 (main, brick), rectangle 3 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 88% of its fill; s35fp-2009-b1 p2 (range, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 83% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The Max A. Mayer house (Burnham & Root, 1888): the register's 'ogee gable with finial, two attic lights, tall chimneys' on a narrow party-wall front, drawn as the kit's shaped street gable over the 2½B brick body, two bays wide. Its ogee curve, carved frieze and bowed window group are T-1913's and T-1914's; the draft keeps only the silhouette. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1339250492 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-prairie-20-22-east-2352.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2352, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1913, T-1914 refine in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35 trace (s35fp-2009-b1), the T-1842 census (s35-2009-front, s35-2009-wing) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35-075 (Mayer/Meyer French Gothic rowhouse); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-20-22-east-2352).
